impact-chain.looks: A heading, then a zig-zag chain of cards joined by dotted lines; each card has a photo on one side and an icon, a coloured figure-title and a paragraph on the other, alternating sides.
impact-chain.use: Telling an impact story as a sequence of three to five results, e.g. '91% Recovery Rate'.
impact-chain.avoid: Results without photos: use Statistics or numbered cards.

fields.icon: Optional small icon by the title.
fields.title: A figure with a few words, e.g. '91% Recovery Rate'.
